name: codex-terminal-title
description: Automatically name Codex terminal tabs from your prompt, then replace them with the generated task title.

commands.title: Codex Terminal Title: New Codex Terminal

codexTaskTerminal.autoDetect.description: Automatically intercept Codex CLI launches in every new integrated terminal.

codexTaskTerminal.codexPath.description: Codex CLI executable name or absolute path in the environment where the extension runs.

codexTaskTerminal.codexArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to Codex CLI.

codexTaskTerminal.titlePrefix.description: Prefix shown before the prompt preview or generated task title.

codexTaskTerminal.promptMaxWidth.description: Maximum terminal display width for the prompt preview before truncation.

codexTaskTerminal.ellipsis.description: Text appended to a truncated prompt preview.

codexTaskTerminal.pollIntervalMs.description: How often the extension checks Codex task metadata for title changes.

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:proxy
scripts.package: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:proxy && npm run build && vsce package
scripts.package:target: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:proxy && npm run build && vsce package --target
